Ready for the maintainer to merge. No blocking findings. Set `merge-ready` because the PR is mergeable and no new failure remains.

The review used upstream/main's current `AGENTS.md`. All builds and tests ran locally, in `.claude/worktrees/review-3862`. No GitHub runner ran.

The trial merge was `2c5fd7d20dd6faffbcca08b87a4a0b242c754cba`, with base `f2aa981b51a3453428fb294c6c71c575a0178ef6`. Its first parent is the PR head above.

What looks good:

- The pocket advice uses `collect_job`, `region_for_job`, and the generator's area controls. It uses the existing `non_sliver_center` predicate.
- The advice stops when it cannot read the same region. It does not estimate the pocket width.
- The Slot refusal runs in the command constructor. The refusal leaves the document unchanged.
- The diff adds a geometry fit query and command validation. It does not change toolpath generation, posting, collision checks, or stock simulation.
- No fixtures, recorded programs, or goldens moved. The body states this under "Goldens moved".

Local results:

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 452 steps: 451 passed, 1 failed, 0 stalled. Tests: 3,999 passed, 1 failed, 111 ignored. |
| MCP directory suite | 39 passed, 0 failed. |
| Fit pins after both mutations were restored | 5 passed, 0 failed. |
| Light lane | All 11 tests passed across all five test steps. |
| `cargo clippy -j 16 -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed. No warnings. |

The light command selected every test step: `cargo xtask gate light --only 'motion light:' --only 'app light:'`. Each step built its required release binary. The motion steps were `lib`, `adaptive_troch_island`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, and `adaptive_troch_parallel`. The app step was `pocket_pass_start`. Full heavy lanes did not run; this P3 change does not require them.

Pre-existing failure, not blocking:

`pass_start_levels::pocket_outside::adaptive_spiral_round_a_part_outside_equals_main_before_3818` failed on the trial merge. I ran the same complete suite on bare base `f2aa981b51a3453428fb294c6c71c575a0178ef6`. It failed there with the same digest mismatch:

```text
left: 131034927421005443
right: 13996707157284497335
```

Both runs had 18 passed and 1 failed test. [Issue #3853](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3853) tracks this failure.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.

These suites ran by name in the quick gate. No fixture or importer change required the extra kernel suites.

Independent mutation checks:

1. I restored `commands/operation/edit.rs` from the fixed base above. The Slot edit pin failed because the invalid width was accepted.
2. I restored `mcp/edit.rs` and `mcp/area.rs` from that base. The Inside pocket pin failed because `set_tool` returned no warning.

I restored all source files after each mutation. All five fit pins then passed. The worktree has no source changes.

Requested before merge: none.

Notes: The UI warning is deferred to [#3859](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/issues/3859), as stated in the body and decision file. This PR changes no UI files. Before/after screenshots are not required for this diff.

The review worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build cache warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Back to draft on purpose: P3 touching operation and motion code (safety tier); the clean review on `71ae93467` was a Codex review, and the safety tier needs an Opus review before merge. Queued; flagged ready again when it is clean.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 71ae934676df880debba5e0bc99283e8b6700d9a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge. This is the Opus safety-tier review. It found no blocking findings.

The review used the `AGENTS.md` of the current upstream/main. All builds and tests ran locally, in `.claude/worktrees/review-3862`. No GitHub runner ran.

Trial merge: `5dd20f083dfd7acc52e716971e203d0c88d13794`. Its first parent is the PR head. The base is upstream/main `16115cd06a3694dfadaa57876c050e6d83c8faab`, which includes #3870.

## Earlier review on this head

The earlier review (the Codex review, same head) had no findings. Its verdict was clean. This review agrees.

## Safety tier: what the diff touches

- Posted G-code: no change. No generator, post, or recorded `.cl`/`.nc` file changes.
- Gouge and collision checks, stock simulation: no change.
- Geometry: one new public predicate, `machining2d::pocket_tool_fits`. It uses the same erosion as `pocket_started_on` (`non_sliver_center(region, d/2 + stock_to_leave)`, `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs:259-264`). It is a read-only query. No generator calls it.
- The advice skips each case where its region can differ from the region that Generate builds. I compared `pocket_fit.rs` with `generate.rs:367-370` and the Pocket arm (`generate.rs:775-803`):
  - Tilted frame: skipped. This is the only case where Generate uses `material_local`.
  - Rotated WCS: skipped.
  - Sketch source: skipped.
  - Rest machining: skipped.
  - The retired Adaptive strategy: skipped.
  - Area controls: the same `apply_area_full` call.
- Avoid regions and corner relief are not in the advice. They can only make the region smaller, so they cannot cause a false warning. At most, a warning is not given. Generate still refuses that case by name, so this is safe.
- The Slot refusal is in the command constructor, before execute. A refused edit changes nothing (the pin compares `get_job`).

## Results (local, on the trial merge)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --lib` | 306 passed, 0 failed |
| All `camcraft-app` integration suites (all of `crates/app/tests/*.rs`, in four chunks) | 0 failed |
| `mcp` directory suite | 39 passed, 0 failed |
| Fit pins (`tool_fit`, `mcp` binary) | 5 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --lib` | 621 passed, 0 failed, 22 ignored |
| All `camcraft-motion` integration suites | 0 failed |
| UI suites in the quick plan (`boundary_picks`, `edge_loop_pick`, `feedback`, `machine`, `operations`, `sinker_setup`) | 57 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

`pass_start_levels::pocket_outside::adaptive_spiral_round_a_part_outside_equals_main_before_3818` failed on the first trial merge (base `9046e1dc8`). It failed in the same way with `crates/motion` set back to that base. #3870 (merged at `16115cd06`) fixes this pin. On the new trial merge, `pass_start_levels` gives 19 passed, 0 failed. This PR did not cause the failure.

Extra suites run:

- `example_catalog`: 39 passed, 0 failed, 4 ignored.
- `example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed.
- `example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed.
- `golden_cl`: 34 passed.
- `mcp_pockets`, `mcp_slot_undercut`, `blind_slot`, `pocket_no_adaptive`, `pocket_pass_start`: all passed.
- No fixture, `testdata/` or importer change. The kernel STEP suites were not necessary.

Goldens moved: none. No recorded program changed. The body says "Goldens moved: None". This is correct.

Heavy lanes: not run. This P3 change does not change a generator. Heavy lanes are not a merge condition.

## Mutations (each one restored after)

1. `commands/operation/edit.rs`: the Slot gate was disabled (`&& false`). Result: red. `edit_operation_refuses_a_slot_width_below_the_tool_without_mutation` failed.
2. `operation/pocket_fit.rs`: the area controls were ignored (`Some(_ctx) => base`). Result: red. `an_outside_pocket_that_the_generator_cuts_has_no_warning` failed.
3. `machining2d/pocket_plan.rs`: `stock_to_leave` was removed from `pocket_tool_fits`. Result: green (the mutation survived). See the follow-up below. This is advice only, so it is not a blocker.

## Law check

- Prime Directive: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` in non-test code. Each failure in the advice gives `None` (no warning), not a crash.
- Everything Is a Command: the Slot refusal is in `EditOperationParams::new`. The MCP warnings are reads after the command.
- Layers and placement: the advice reads the ECS world, so it is correct in `crates/app`. The predicate is in `camcraft-motion`. No new crate dependency.
- Provenance line: present on `pocket_fit.rs` and on the new test file.
- Body: has `Changelog:`, `Fixes #3631`, "Goldens moved", and a decision file. No process file changed. No UI file changed, so screenshots are not necessary.
- Issue scope: the UI part of #3631 is split to #3859. The body and the decision file say this.

Requested before merge: none.

## Optional, non-blocking (follow-ups for the merging session to file)

1. P7, test gap: no pin has a pocket where the tool fits alone but does not fit with `stock_to_leave` (mutation 3 survived). Example: an 8 mm pocket, a 6 mm tool and 1.5 mm stock to leave. The pin must give a warning and a refusal from `generate`.
2. P7, drift guard: `pocket_started_on` (`pocket.rs:259-264`) and `pocket_avoid.rs:117` repeat the erosion expression. They do not call `pocket_tool_fits`. If the generators call the new predicate, the advice and Generate cannot drift apart.
3. P7, file size: `crates/app/src/mcp/edit.rs` grows from 401 to 406 lines (the limit is about 400). The name `clearance_warning` now also says the pocket fit. A rename (for example `edit_warnings`) can go with a split.
4. P7, agent surface: the `camcraft-mcp` skill rows for `set_tool` and `set_operation_area` do not say that the reply can have `warning`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merging as SAME (no head movement since the counted review). The review that stands: `<!-- pr-reviewer: 71ae934676df880debba5e0bc99283e8b6700d9a -->` by mkinney (Opus, clean), at head `71ae934676df880debba5e0bc99283e8b6700d9a`. Merge commit pinned with `--match-head-commit`.
